install:
set -euo pipefail
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y -qq python3.12-venv curl >/dev/null
cd backend
if [ ! -d .venv ]; then python3 -m venv .venv; fi
. .venv/bin/activate
pip install -q -r requirements.txt
pip install -q httpx
cd ../frontend
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; else npm install; fi
start:
set -euo pipefail
cd backend
. .venv/bin/activate
if curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo 'API already healthy on :8000'
  exit 0
fi
nohup uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 >/tmp/findhackathons-api.log 2>&1 &
for i in $(seq 1 40); do
  if curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo 'API healthy on :8000'
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 0.5
done
echo 'API failed to become healthy; last log:'
tail -n 40 /tmp/findhackathons-api.log || true
exit 1
